entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Shinshōgokuraku-ji (真正極楽寺) or Shinnyo-dō (真如堂) is a Buddhist Tendai temple in Kyoto. It was established in 984 AD by the monk Kaisan, who was originally from Enryaku-ji. The word gokuraku in its name refers to Sukhāvatī, the Pure Land of the West. Shinshōgokuraku-ji Temple is a Buddhist temple in Asia, established in 984 CE. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
